summary: Lumen Technologies filed an 8-K announcing that its indirect subsidiary Level 3 Financing plans a $1 billion private offering of Senior Notes due 2037. Concurrently, Level 3 Financing, Lumen, and Qwest Capital Funding commenced cash tender offers to purchase up to $750 million aggregate principal of 13 series of outstanding notes, including Level 3, Lumen, and QCF notes, at an unspecified price. The tender offers are subject to terms in the Offer to Purchase dated May 6, 2026, with the offering expected to close May 21, 2026. Proceeds will fund the tenders. Watch for proration and any increase in the aggregate purchase price.
